rites.name: Serisanum
rites.text: A repeated maneuver where a fighter delivers a pair of decisive strikes in quick succession to end a struggle. It recurs across many contests as a signature technique.

rites.name: Thiashis
rites.text: Thiashis is the concept of the first tone that the roots of Elaelys struck when they condensed out of the Singing, a note that taught the nascent groves how to hold their shape against the drift. Within the Age of the first sovereign it is remembered as the reason growing kingdoms learned to bind their borders with living wood.

rites.name: Tharnorde
rites.text: Tharnorde is the concept of the bound oath, the force that holds a sworn promise to the world it was spoken in. In the Courts of Elaelys it is what keeps the first sovereign's word true across the building of the doors between worlds.

rites.name: Ceontia
rites.text: A male-only calling in which a practitioner reads hidden futures to guide others. It is a craft passed among men who study the threads of fate.

rites.name: Osumamuta
rites.text: Osumamuta is the concept of the Seeding, the quiet season in Elaelys when the makers sow the Weave and the dormant powers of the Arcane Realm lie still beneath the soil. It is remembered as a hush before growth, when every latent force waits in patient stillness for its time to wake.

rites.name: Silaemora
rites.text: Silaemora is a concept of Elaelys, the thread of quiet powers that the makers plant into the Weave during the Seeding, when sleeping forces are woken and bound. In the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, it is taught as the hidden grammar beneath every rite and fire.

rites.name: Venarlora
rites.text: Venarlora is the concept of the Pact-thread, the binding that held the worlds of Elaelys together until the Fall and the Sundering. In the Age of Sundering its strands snapped as landfall broke old bonds, and the Shards that remained are said to still carry fragments of its oath.

rites.name: Shyuvseth
rites.text: Shyuvseth is a concept of the Elaelys omniverse, the idea of a rupture that splits a world into fragments and forces the surviving powers to swear a binding Pact. It is remembered as the principle that made the Fall, the Sundering and the Shards thinkable, and it still marks the boundary between old bonds and new ones.

rites.name: Grimuzhar
rites.text: Grimuzhar is a concept in the Elaelys Arcane Realm, born in the Fall of the Sundering era, when worlds broke apart and the Pact was sworn. It stands as a bound idea that holds old oaths together while the Shards drift apart.

rites.name: Coresiantia
rites.text: A calling practiced by one wanderer who alone has access to it, available from the very start. It is a craft of uncovering hidden truths.

rites.name: Seraneostor
rites.text: A chargeable finishing blow that comes in separate striking and kicking forms. A fighter can learn it at a training hall after paying a fee and defeating a set number of practice dummies.

rites.name: Telilanum
rites.text: A sung ballad performed in a public hall by a pair of singers and their troupe. It is offered as a heartfelt number during a stage showcase for a ruling circle of performers.

rites.name: Orintialus
rites.text: A combat discipline practiced by men alone, pursued as a trade of performed strikes and bold showmanship. It is one of several crafts a wanderer can take up and master.

rites.name: Valia
rites.text: A recurring grappling technique practiced by a famous brawler, ending a fight by seizing an opponent in a decisive hold. It is linked to one particular fighter who uses it often.

rites.name: Ameonirnor
rites.text: A paired performance tradition in which a hooded dancer cannot move alone and must find a partner to complete the routine. It is one of the chronicled rites recorded for a wandering warrior.

rites.name: Vontor
rites.text: A coded craft in which a wanderer's chosen blooms carry hidden messages between hidden allies. The practice is recorded as a personal side tale of one wanderer.

rites.name: Sialasium
rites.text: A short three-part narrative mode centered on one figure, where each part sparks a contest and grants rewards. Playing it costs a shared energy pool, and it is told either through the figure's eyes or through an outsider who meets them.

rites.name: Neontasum
rites.text: Multipliers that amplify the experience gathered during combat. Many of them activate only when a particular condition is met, while others grow stronger through gear and improvements.
